description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to network information management within the Thunder::Core namespace, including RoutingTable, AdapterObserver, IPV4AddressIterator, IPV6AddressIterator, Network, and AdapterIterator. It contains class definitions, method declarations, and includes external dependencies, primarily for network routing and interface enumeration.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents a network routing table with nested Route class for individual routes.

classes.name: RoutingTable::Route
classes.description: Represents a single network route with source, destination, gateway, and other routing parameters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for network adapter events, with callback interface for notifications.

classes.name: AdapterObserver::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving network adapter events such as Event, Added, and Removed.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator for IPv4 addresses associated with network adapters, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator for IPv6 addresses, platform-specific, alias for IPV4AddressIterator on non-Windows platforms.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface with methods for managing IP addresses, MAC, and status.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator for network adapters, providing access to adapter properties like name, MAC, status, and IP addresses.

methods.name: Route()
methods.description: Default constructor for Route class, initializes routing parameters to default values.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for Route class, copies routing parameters.

methods.name: Source()
methods.description: Returns the source NodeId of the route.

methods.name: Destination()
methods.description: Returns the destination NodeId of the route.

methods.name: Gateway()
methods.description: Returns the gateway NodeId for the route.

methods.name: Preferred()
methods.description: Returns the preferred NodeId for the route.

methods.name: Metrics()
methods.description: Returns the metrics value for the route.

methods.name: Priority()
methods.description: Returns the priority of the route.

methods.name: Interface()
methods.description: Returns the interface name associated with the route.
